title: Learning from Runtime Feedback through Failure-Bank Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generalize broadly across robotic manipulation tasks, but complex environments require balancing task success with unintended contact. Runtime shields can correct individual actions, but they leave the underlying policy unchanged, so repeated disagreements may create a persistent policy-shield mismatch that blocks task progress. To address this challenge, we introduce FailBank, a four-stage self-evolving framework that converts runtime feedback into persistent policy improvement. During collection, a fixed CBF-based safety module serves as an observe-only teacher, producing counterfactual corrections while the policy remains in control. Outcome-aware admission then converts useful proposals into corrective targets and retains successful uncorrected actions as quiet anchors for guarded LoRA updates. We evaluate FailBank on the VLA-Arena benchmark across two difficulty levels and two VLA backbones. Com

translated_title: 通过失败库自进化从运行时反馈中学习，面向视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在各类机器人操作任务中具有广泛的泛化能力，但复杂环境要求在任务成功与意外接触之间取得平衡。运行时防护机制虽然可以纠正单个动作，却不会改变底层策略，因此反复出现的分歧可能造成持续的策略-防护不匹配，从而阻碍任务进展。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 FailBank，一个四阶段自进化框架，可将运行时反馈转化为持续的策略改进。在收集阶段，一个固定的基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的安全模块充当“仅观察”的教师，在策略保持控制权的同时产生反事实纠正。随后，结果感知的准入机制将有用的建议转化为纠正目标，并保留成功的未纠正动作作为“安静锚点”，用于受保护的 LoRA 更新。我们在 VLA-Arena 基准上，跨两个难度级别和两个 VLA 骨干网络对 FailBank 进行了评估。
tldr: FailBank 是一个四阶段自进化框架，通过收集基于 CBF 的安全模块产生的运行时反事实纠正反馈，并利用结果感知准入机制将其转化为纠正目标和“安静锚点”，以受保护的 LoRA 更新实现 VLA 模型策略的持续改进，从而解决策略与安全防护之间的持续不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: FailBank is a four-stage self-evolving framework that collects counterfactual corrections from a CBF-based runtime safety module and uses outcome-aware admission to convert useful proposals into corrective targets and "quiet anchors" for guarded LoRA updates, enabling persistent policy improvement in VLA models to resolve the persistent policy-shield mismatch.
